name: CREB regulated transcription coactivator 3
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CRTC3 encodes CREB-regulated transcription coactivator 3. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and cAMP response element binding protein binding. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and macrophage activation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pulmonary mucoepidermoid carcinoma; Mucoepidermoid carcinoma of salivary gland. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
